title: InputNamesAPlaceholder payload
description: An `--input` value holding a placeholder (`{task}`, `{run_directory}`, `{input.<name>}`, any `{` word `}` of the placeholder shape). A value is filled in as text and never read again for placeholders, so one that names any is refused rather than left to look like one. The refusal's code is `unsupported_construct` at `driver-steps[<map>].inputs.<name>` (map.rs `StepMap::check_inputs`).
